s: Dine deleqa beshabbat ubo k"t seipim: nopla deleqa beshabbat — gazeru chakamim shello yatztzilu kelum mippaneha, apillu lemaqom hammuttar betiltul, vachapatzim hammuttarim betiltul, vaapillu okalim umashqim lo yatztzil ella mah shetztzarik lo leotah shabbat bilbad, kegon im nopla belel shabbat qodem hasseudda — matztzil mezon g' seuddot, harauy leadam — leadam, harauy libhema — libhema, ubeshacharit — mezon shette seuddot, ubammincha — mezon seudda achat, sheim yihyeh muttar lehatztzil kol chapatzayv — yesh lachush shemmechamat tirdat hahatztzala shehu bahul venechpaz lehatztzil yishkach shehayyom shabbat veyabo lekabbot haddeleqa:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Babbayit shehaddeleqa bo, abal battim haqqerobim vireim shettaggia lahem haddeleqa — yekolim lehatztzil kol mah sheyyirtzu, lepi shehem enan behulin kol kak sheyyishkechu hashshabbat mechamat tirdat hahatztzala. Vaapillu maot o shear debarim hammuqtzim hachashubim — muttar lahem lehatztzil, vehu haddin shemmuttar letaltelam kede lehatztzilam mippene hallistim o, mippene abde hammoshel habbaim lechappes betebato vekayyotze beinyan zeh, lepi shello gazeru kelal al tiltul muqtzeh bimqom hepsed merubbeh, ella im ken epshar lehatztzil beinyan acher, kegon mi sheshshakach arnaqi barechob, sheasur lahabiah lebeto apillu beir hamorebet, mippene sheyyakol lehoshib sham shomer o lishmor beatzmo, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"v, veken kol kayyotze beinyan zeh. Abal yesh oserim tiltul muqtzeh vaapillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh vei epshar lehatztzil beinyan acher. Veken iqqar. Veap al pi ken yesh omerim shemmuttar lehatztzil maot vekayyotze bahem mippene haddeleqa o mippene hallistim, lepi sheadam bahul al mamono ubevadday yatztzilem mehepsed, veim lo nattir lo lehatztzil al yede tiltul muqtzeh yabo lide issur chamur sheyyekabbeh haddeleqa, o sheyyachpirem veyatminem baqqarqa vekayyotze beinyan zeh. (Veap sheyyakol lehatztzilam bilbad, mikkol maqom mechamat shehu bahul venechpaz behatztzalatam — yemaher lehatztzilam bekol hatztzala shettizdammen lo yoter bimhera ap shehi beissur chamur, ki yomar ek sheatztzil lo atztzil behetter, mah sheen ken keshehittiru lo lehatztzil al yede tiltul — lo yatztzil al yede issur chamur). Umittaam zeh yesh mattirin apillu lehotzi derek karmelit kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a, abal lepi sheharbeh choleqin al hetter zeh, lepikak en lehaqel ella beissur tiltul, sheyyesh omerim shello gazeru kelal tiltul muqtzeh bimqom hepsed merubbeh, abal bekarmelit en lehaqel kelal. Vegam apillu betiltul lebad en lehaqel ella bebattim haqqerobim laddeleqa, abal babbayit shehaddeleqa bo — apillu mezonot asur lehatztzil yoter mig' seuddot, vekol shekken maot. Vekol zeh bidleqa velistim vekayyotze bazeh shehaddabar bahul (venechpaz hu) meod (lehatztzil mippenehem), abal im yaredu geshamim al sechora hammuqtzeh, kevan sheen haddabar bahul kol kak — en lachush sheyyabo lehatztzil al yede issur chamur im neesor lo hattiltul, velaken en hetter bezeh vekol kayyotze bazeh, ella letaltel al yede nokri im yesh sham hepsed gadol, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z:

Hitztzil pat neqiyya leshalosh seuddot — lo yachazir veyatztzil pat hadraa. Abal im hitztzil pat hadraa — yakol lachazor ulehatztzil pat neqiyya, ki yakol lehaarim velomar bepat neqiyya ani chapetz. Veken yakol lehaarim lehatztzil shalosh seuddot mikkol min, sheim hitztzil basar shalosh seuddot — yakol lehatztzil achar kak dagim, sheyyakol lomar bedagim ani chapetz, veken shear kol hamminim. Vaapillu yesh lo mah yokal bemaqom acher kol hashshabbat — rashshay lehatztzil g' seuddot mehaddeleqa. Lepikak, apillu im hitztzil hu harbeh — rashshaim bene beto lehatztzil kol echad g' seuddot ap al pi sheyyesh lahem mah yoklu mimmah shehitztzil hu:

Matztzilin miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat, kegon im chal yom hakkippurim beereb shabbat. Veap sheakshav lepi haqqebiut shebbeyadenu i epshar sheyyihyeh yom hakkippurim beereb shabbat, mikkol maqom gam im chal beHashem veyodea shello yimtza liqnot beereb shabbat — matztzilin bo g' seuddot leshabbat. Abal en matztzilin mishshabbat leyom hakkippurim veyom tob, velo leshabbat habbaa. Abal beyom hakkippurim lemotzae yom hakkippurim — matztzilin mezon seudda achat, mippene agmat nepesh:
Matztzilin lecholeh ulezaqen uleraabtan kebenoni:

Lo aseru lehatztzil yoter mig' seuddot ella keshemmotzi vechozer umotzi, abal keshemmotzi hakkol bepaam achat — muttar. Vehu shello yihyu bekelim harbeh, ella bikli echad. Lepikak, matztzilin sal male kikkarot ap al pi sheyyesh bo mea seuddot, veiggul shel debela, vechabit shel yayin. Vaapillu im peras tallito vehebi okalin vehinniach letoko, vechazar vehebi vehinniach — muttar. Ap al pi shettoreach leesop veliknos harbeh peamim — en bekak kelum, shekkevan shemmotzi hakkol bepaam achat — hatztzala achat hi. Vaapillu hayu haokalin bekelim umeareh otam letok hattallit — muttar. Abal lehanniach harbeh kelim meleim okalim tok hattallit ulehotziam bebat achat — asur, kevan shehem bekelim mechullaqim, velo hittiru lehatztzil ella bikli echad:

Keshem shehu eno rashshay lehatztzil yoter mig' seuddot — kak acherim enam rashshaim lehatztzil lo. Abal muttar lo lomar lahem "bou vehatztzilu lakem" ap al pi sheyyodea bahem sheyyachaziru lo, ubilbad shello yatztzilu kol echad yoter mig' seuddot bikli echad. Veap al pi sheenam behulim kol kak al haddeleqa sheyyabou lekabbotah — ap al pi ken lo chillequ chakamim bigzeratam. Veim hem rotzim yekolim lizkot leatzman bemah shehitztzilu, kevan shehu amar lahem "hatztzilu lakem", hare hipqir lahem, vezaku min hahepqer. Veim hem yire shamayim veenan rotzim lizkot, kevan sheyyodeim shello meretzono hipqir, ella rotzim lehachazir lo uleqabbel sakar al torach hatztzalatam — hareshut beyadam, veen bezeh mishshum sekar shabbat, shehare hakkol shellahem shezzaku bo min hahepqer, ella shehem mochalim lo hammotar al kede sekaram, abal ad kede sekaram enan mochalin lo veshellahem hu shezzaku bo min hahepqer, veeno niqra sekar shabbat kelal. Umiddat chasidut shello littol sakar al torach hatztzala shebbeshabbat ap al pi sheeno sekar shabbat, ki hechasid yesh lo levatter mishshello bekol dabar sheyyesh bo nidnud abera. Abal im lo amar lahem "hatztzilu lakem" — enam yekolim lizkot leatzman kelal im ratzu, ap al pi shehu eno rashshay lehatztzil yoter, ki eno hepqer bishbil kak, mippene shello nityaesh mimmennu adayin, ki yakol lomar ani hayiti mamtzi li anashim shehayu matztzilin leatzman umachazirim li, ulepikak en hallalu shehitztzilu rashshaim littol sakar, mippene shehu sekar shabbat, kevan shello zaku bo min hahepqer:
Muttar lo lehatztzil kele tashmisho hatztzerikim lo hayyom (leg' seuddot hallalu), kegon kosot veqitoniyyot (vekayyotze bah mishshear kele seudda):

Kol hatztzala sheamarnu enah ella lechatzer acheret hamorebet im chatzer zo, abal lo lesheenah meorebet, veen tzarik lomar lekarmelit, shello hittiru issur dibre soperim bishbil g' seuddot shel shabbat, ella hahatztzala bilbaddah:

Vekol zeh bimzonot ukele tashmisho hannittalim beyad, abal begadim sheyyakol lelobsham — muttar lo lilbosh velaatop kol mah sheyyakol laatop umotzi uposhet, vechozer velobesh umotzi, apillu kol hayyom kullo, shekkevan shello hittiru lehatztzil ella bederek lebisha — zakur hu velo yabo lekabbot. Vaapillu lirshut harabbim muttar lo lehotzi bederek lebisha (apillu lobesh bo beinyan sheen derek lilbosh ken bechol, kegon b' chagorot zo al gabbe zo, veap al pi sheyyesh omerim shehashsheni hu kemassoy kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a, mikkol maqom bidleqa heqellu). Veyakol lomar laacherim "bou vehatztzilu li", vehem lobeshim kol mah sheyyekolim lilbosh, veotepim kol mah sheyyekolim laatop, umotziim uposhetim, vechozerim velobeshim umotziim:

Yesh omerim shello aseru lehatztzil yoter mig' seuddot ukele tashmisho hatztzerikim lo hayyom ella keshemmatztzil lechatzer hamorebet o lemaboy hamorab, shehen semukim lirshut harabbim, vegam enan meqorin, vedomeh qetzat lirshut harabbim, abal lebayit acher sheereb immo — yakol lehotzi kol mah sheyyirtzeh. Veap lechatzer lo aseru ella lachatzar chabero shehi tzerika leareb immo, ap al pi sheereb immo, abal lechatzer shello sheen tzarik erub kelal — yakol lehotzi kol mah sheyyirtzeh. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq kelal bekol zeh, shekkevan shettaam haissur hu mishshum chashash kibbuy — mah li [le]chatzer mah li labbayit, mah li lachatzar chabero mah li lachatzero. Veyesh lachush ledibrehem:

Kol kitbe haqqodesh matztzilin otam mippene haddeleqa. Ubime chakme hattalmud lo nittenu likkateb ella k"d separim, abal lo tora shebbeal peh, velo kol habberakot vehattepillot shettiqqenu chakamim, ella hayu beal peh. Veap k"d separim lo nittenu likkateb ella al or behema tehora, ubiktab ashshuri, uleshon haqqodesh, ubidyo, abal lo al hanneyar, velo biktab o lashon acher, apillu targum, ella hayu metargemin beal peh, velo bemine tzibonim, kemo shennitbaer besimman l"b gabbe tepillin. Veim niktebu biktab o lashon acher — apillu bechol asur liqrot bahem, ella mannicham bimqom hatturpa, vehem mitabbedim mealehem im haazkarot shebbahem hakketubot gam ken beoto ketab o lashon. Ulepikak, en matztzilim otam beshabbat mippene haddeleqa, velo (mimmayim) o shear dabar hamabbedam, mippene shehem asurim betiltul (vegam bechol en lehatztzilam, ella yannichem sheyyobdu). Abal im ketubim bilshon haqqodesh uketab ashshuri al neyar o bemine tzibonim, ap al pi sheasur liqrot bahem apillu bechol — ap al pi ken matztzilin otam mippene haddeleqa beshabbat, mippene haazkarot shebbahem. Chutz mimmegillat ester sheen bah azkarot, mippene shennishtallecha likkateb bedate paras umaday, ulepikak en bah qedushsha ella im ken ketuba kehilkatah. Vekol zeh bimehem, abal akshav mishshum "et laasot laHashem heperu torateka" — hittiru liktob kol hasseparim, apillu shel tora shebbeal peh, vekol habberakot vehattepillot, mippene shennitmaet halleb venitrabba hashshikcha, velaken matztzilin otam mippene haddeleqa umikkol meqom hatturpa beshabbat. Veken hittiru mishshum "et laasot laHashem vego'" liktob apillu k"d separim targum, vekol lashon, ubekol ketab al hanneyar, mippene sheen kol adam yakol liktob ashshurit, vegam en hakkol mebinim leshon haqqodesh, vegam en sippeq beyad hakkol liqnot haqqelap, velaken matztzilim otam gam ken mippene haddeleqa umikkol meqom hatturpa. Abal mikkol maqom asur lekotbam bemine tzibonim apillu bizman hazzeh, mippene shebbeqal yukal liqnot deyo kemo mine tzibonim, veim niktebu asur liqrot bahem apillu bechol. Veap al pi ken matztzilin otan mippene haddeleqa umikkol meqom hatturpa, mippene haazkarot shebbahem, chutz mimmegillat ester sheen bah azkarot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshenniktebu biktab ashshurit uleshon haqqodesh, abal biktab o lashon acher — muttar lekotbam apillu bemine tzibonim, veqorin bahem, umatztzilin otam. Vekol zeh bek"d separim shel tora shebbiktab, abal shear separim — muttar liktob bemine tzibonim bekol inyan, veqorin bahem, umatztzilin otam:

Lo hittiru bizman hazzeh liktob bishar leshonot ella kesheoto haam beqiin beoto lashon, abal im enan mebinim oto — asur liktob. Veen qorin bo, veen matztzilim oto (ben bek"d separim, ben bishar separim shel tora shebbeal peh), shehare lo hittiru ella mishshum "et laasot laHashem", ukesheen haam mebinim — lo shayyak "et laasot laHashem". (Veken asur liktob shemot sheenan nimchaqin o pesuqim beqameot o bishar meqomot shello shayyak bahem "et laasot laHashem"). Vaapillu koteb ashshurit velashon haqqodesh ubidyo al haqqelap — hare lo nittena tora likkateb ella seper shalem, velo parashiyyot parashiyyot, ella mishshum "et laasot laHashem", kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman rap"[g], ulepikak en qorin bahem, veen matztzilin otam beshabbat mippene haddeleqa, shehare enan biklal kitbe haqqodesh. (Abal matztzilim otam mimmayim o shear debarim hamabbedam, shehare enam asurim betiltul, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch, sheapillu qamea sheeno mumcheh muttar letaltelo). Umikkan ameru chakamim kotebe qamein, vekol kayyotze bahem middebarim shello shayyak lomar bahem "et laasot laHashem" — hare hem kesorepe tora, shehare lo yatztzilu otam mippene haddeleqa beshabbat, veyannichum lissarep. Veyesh omerim shemmuttar liktob ulehatztzil, shekkevan shennittan reshut liktob azkarot bibrakot, veken pesuqim shebbesiddure tepillot vetachanunim, mishshum "et laasot laHashem" — hu haddin shennittan reshut lekotbam beqameot o shear meqomot, ap al pi shello shayyak bahem "et laasot laHashem", ubilbad shello yiktebem bemaqom sheyyukelu labo lide bizzayon, kegon beiggerot, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman ra"v. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona:
Tora shebbiktab qodemet lehatztzil letora shebbeal peh:

Seper tora shebbala o nimchaq veyesh bo lelaqqet p"h otiyyot, ap al pi sheen bahem azkara — hare hu omed biqdushshato umatztzilin oto, lepi shekken matzinu seper shalem battora sheen bo ella p"h otiyyot, dehaynu parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron", shennechsheba leseper bipne atzmo. Vehu shep"h otiyyot ellu hen tebot shelemot, ap al pi shehen mepuzzarot, abal teba shennechsar mimmenna ot achat — en hannishar mimmenna mitztarep laalot lecheshbon p"h. Veim yesh beseper tora zo azkara achat shelema — matztzilin otah bishbilah lebaddah ap al pi shehashshear kullah nimchaq ubala:
Tebot shel targum shebbammiqra, kegon "yegar sahaduta" ve"kidna temeron lehom" shekketabo bilshon haqqodesh — ap al pi ken hen mitztorpot veolot lecheshbon p"h:

Kol dabar shemmatztzilim oto mippene qedushshato — matztzilin oto apillu lechatzer sheenah meorebet, o lemaboy sheen bo shittup, ubilbad sheyyihyu kol tiqqunayv qayyamim, dehaynu g' mechitztzot velechi o qora, shello heqellu bekitbe haqqodesh ella leinyan chesron tiqqun haerub o hashshittup bilbad, abal lo leinyan chesron tiqqun acher, ben bemaboy ben bechatzer:

Matztzilin tiq hasseper im hasseper vetiq hattepillin im hattepillin apillu lechatzer sheenah meorebet ap al pi sheyyesh betokam maot, velo hitzrikuhu lenaer hammaot mehem, ki shemma betok kak titchazzeq haddeleqa velo yukal lehatztzilam kelal. Veken im hinniach tepillin bearnaqi melea maot — yakol lehatztzilah mippene haddeleqa o mippene haggannabim vehaggazlanim lemaqom sheyyakol lehatztzil hattepillin. Veen mechayyebim oto lehotzi hattepillin mimmenna apillu hinnichan betokah beshabbat (al yede nokri), sheal yede yisrael asur lehatznia tepillin betokah, shei epshar shello yetaltelenna qetzat vehi basis lehammaot shebbetokah. Abal lekattechilla asur lehanniach tepillin letokah bishat haddeleqa kede sheyyatztzil aggab hattepillin, shehare lo hittiru ella mechamat chashash shemma lo yukal lehatztzil hattepillin kelal im yitztarek lehotziam mimmenna, veek yannichen sham lekattechilla? Abal muttar lehanniach betokah tepillin meereb shabbat, kede sheyyukal lehatztzilah immahen beshabbat lechatzer sheenah meorebet im tippol deleqa o mippene gannabim vehaggazlanim, kevan shemmannichan bishat hetter, vehu haddin limzuza o seper. Abal im manniach (tabbaat o) okalin letok arnaqi — enan moilin sheyyukal lehatztzilah al yede kak mibbayit shehaddeleqa bo apillu lechatzer hamorebet, ki en (hattabbaat o) haokalin chashubim legabbe haarnaqi, vehen betelin etzlah, ulepikak, ap im i epshar lenaaran mimmenna — eno rashshay littol et haarnaqi bishbilan, ella yannichen lissarep im haarnaqi. Veyesh mattirin lehanniach aleha apillu lekattechilla bishat haddeleqa kikkar o tinoq, o shear dabar shemmuttar lehatztzilo lechatzer hamorebet, ap al pi shehaarnaqi chashuba mimmennu harbeh, venotelah umatztzilah al yede kak mibbayit shehaddeleqa bo lechatzer hamorebet. Veap shello ameru kikkar o tinoq ella lemet bilbad kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"a, mikkol maqom mippene hepsed haddeleqa heqellu gam ken kemo bemet, shettehe haarnaqi tepela ledabar hammuttar shealeha, vahare zeh kematztzil dabar hammuttar bilbaddo. Veyesh lismok al zeh lehaqel bedibre soperim bimqom hepsed merubbeh. Vekol zeh babbayit shehaddeleqa bo, abal bebattim haqqerobim — yesh mattirin letaltel apillu muqtzeh bilbad im yesh bo hepsed merubbeh, vehu haddin mippene hallistim, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Yesh mattirin lomar lenokri lehatztzil separim apillu derek reshut harabbim, shello gazeru al shebut amira lenokri bimqom bizyon kitbe haqqodesh. Veap shello hittiru lehatztzilan lekarmelit, ap al pi sheen issurah ella shebut middibre soperim, mikkol maqom eno domeh shebut hannaaseh al yede yisrael lishbut amira lenokri:

Haggilyonim shellemala veshellematta, veshebben parasha leparasha, veshebben dap ledap, veshebben seper leseper — en matztzilin otam im nechteku min hasseper, o shennimchaq hasseper velo nishtayyeru bo p"h otiyyot:

Hamminim, dehaynu haaduqim baaboda zara, veken mumarim laaboda zara, shekkatebu lahem kitbe haqqodesh, ap al pi shekketubim ashshurit bilshon haqqodesh al haqqelap ubidyo — en matztzilin otam, veap bechol sorepam im haazkarot shebbahem, mippene shekkevan shehem aduqim baaboda zara — bevadday katebu otan leshem aboda zara. Umikkan yesh lehazhir al otan matbeot shel zahab vakesep sheyyesh alehen shem ben d' otiyyot shettabeu oto hamminim leshem aboda zara, sheasur litlotam, vegam en lehachaziq otan birshuto, ella yattikem miyyad, kede shello yihyeh zikkaron lemaasehem sheasu leshem aboda zara, shemmittaam zeh tzarik lisrop hasseparim shellahem im haazkarot shebbahem:

Teba sheachaz bah haur mitztziddah haechad — muttar littol or shel gedi hammuttar betiltul, al derek shennitbaer besimman sh"ch, velipros oto aleha samuk laur, kede shello yitpashshet haur yoter, shehaor hu mitcharek veeno nisrap umegin al hatteba. Umuttar laasot mechitztza bekol hakkelim, ben reqanim ben meleim, lehapsiq haddeleqa. Vaapillu bikle cheres chadashim meleim mayim, ap al pi shehem enam yekolim leqabbel et haur umitbaqqeim umekabbim et haddeleqa — lo gazeru bimqom hepsed al geram kibbuy kazeh, shebbeshaa shennoten hammayim yesh dabar hammapsiq benam laur, dehaynu dopne hakkele shennotenam betoko vehaur hu shemmebaqqea et hakkeli umekabbeh et atzmo, vehaadam hannoten mayim eno ella gorem beolma, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"h:

Tallit sheachaz bah haur mitztzad echad — muttar litten aleha mashqin rachoq qetzat min haur kede sheyyikbeh haur kesheyyaggia lesham. Veap al pi sheen kan dabar hammapsiq benam laur, mikkol maqom hem enam mekabbin kelal mah shennidlaq kebar, ella shemmoneim haur millidloq yoter, vehu kabeh meelayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemashqim sheenam melabbenim, abal mayim o shear mashqim hamlabbenim — asur litten al hattallit, mishshum gezerat sechita, o mishshum sheshsheriyyat habbeged zehu kibbuso, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"b veshay"t:

Tallit mequppelet sheachaz bah haur — poshetah umitkasseh bah, kede shello yitpashshet haur yoter. Veap im al yede zeh nikbeh mah shennidlaq kebar — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno mitkavven lekak, velav "pesiq resheh hu". Velaken lo yarutz veyiqpotz vinaanea otah aneh vaana kede sheyyikbeh, ella mitkasseh bah kedarkah. Veken seper tora sheachaz bo haur — posheto veqore bo, kede shello yitpashshet bo haur yoter. Veap im al yede zeh nikbeh mah shennidlaq kebar — en bekak kelum, ubilbad shello yenaanea oto aneh vaana:

Asur lomar lenokri lekabbot haddeleqa mishshum hepsed mamono, apillu lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupa enah asura ella middibre soperim, vehakkibbuy hi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"ch, ubimqom hepsed gadol yesh lehattir amira lenokri bedabar sheeno asur leyisrael ella middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z, mikkol maqom kan bidleqa shehaddabar bahul venechpaz hu meod lehatztzil mamono veen libbo alayv, veim nattir lo kelum — ap hu lo yitten debarayv leshiurim veyabo lekabbot beatzmo. (Umittaam zeh asur gam ken lehatztzil al yede nokri babbayit shehaddeleqa bo yoter mig' seuddot ukele tashmisho hatztzerikim lo hayyom, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Abal muttar lomar lo lekabbot mippene separim, im i epshar beinyan acher:

Nokri shebba lekabbot meatzmo — en tzarik limchot beyado, lepi shehannokri yesh lo shiqqul haddaat, sheshshoqel bedato shekkak rauy lo laasot, mippene sheyyistakker bo akshav o leachar zeman, velahanaat atzmo hu mitkavven. Vaapillu hu abdo hammuskar lo lizman — en tzarik limchot bo, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rm"d. Abal qatan shebba lekabbot — tzarik limchot beyado, apillu lo higgia lechinnuk, vaapillu en abiv sham, lepi shehaqqatan en lo shiqqul haddaat sheyyitkavven lahanaat atzmo, ella kevan sheyyodea sheddeleqa zo hi hepsed leabiv (o leyisrael acher) — hare hu mekabbeh min hassetam bishbilo kede laasot lo nachat ruach. Abal qatan hamchallel shabbat lahanaat atzmo — en tzarik limchot bo, ella abiv bilbad im higgia lechinnuk, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"g:
Bidleqa hittiru lomar bipne hannokri — "kol hamkabbeh eno mapsid". Veim eno kan — yakol liqroto lekan velomar ken bepanayv, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z:

Yesh omerim shekkol mah sheaseru chakamim bidleqa — lo aseru ella bimehem shello hayu sheruyim ben hannokrim, vaapillu begalutam hayu lahem meqomot leatzmam, abal bizman hazzeh otam sheshsheruyim ben hannokrim veyesh chashash sakkanat nepashot keshehaddeleqa mitgabberet, sheaz hem chotepim vesholelim, ukesheadam maamid atzmo al mamono yabou laharog oto — muttar lekabbot haddeleqa beshabbat, apillu haddeleqa hi bebet nokri, ki yesh lachush pen titgabber haddeleqa veyabou lachatop velishlol velaharog, vekol hazzariz lekabbot — hare zeh meshubbach. Umikkol maqom, hakkol lepi hainyan, sheim hem betuchim bevadday shello yihyeh lahem sakkana baddabar — asur lekabbot, abal bachashash sepeq sakkanat nepashot — muttar lekabbot. Veken nohagin. Umikkol maqom, lo heqellu ella bekibbuy haddeleqa, shehi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, veyesh chashash sakkana im lo yekabbeh, abal mishshum hatztzalat mamono — asur lechallel shabbat apillu bimlaka sheenah tzerika legupah, vaapillu bedabar sheiqqaro middibre soperim, kegon issur techumin. Veim abar vechillel — tzarik kappara. Vehakkappara — hiskimu haacharonim sheyyitanneh m' yom, ap al pi sheenan retzuppim, ella b' veHashem. Velo yokal basar velo yishteh yayin balayla sheachar hattaanit. Veyitten y"ch peshutim litzdaqa bimqom chattat im nitchayyeb bah, vehu shiur sela shel tora. Vekamma shiur sela bematbeot shellanu — yitbaer beyoreh dea simman sh"h, ayyen sham. Veim yirtzeh lipdot hattaanit — yitten bead kol yom leerek y"b peshutim im epshar lo. Veheashir yitten yoter, hakkol lepi oshro, shehare taam happidyon sheshshaqul tzaar hammamon keneged tzaar hattaanit, ubeashir din mea maneh kedin peruta leani. Veim yukal lidchot hattaanit limot hachorep — yitbaer besimman taqas"[ch]. Vekol zeh bimchallel shabbat bishbil hatztzalat mamon, abal hamkabbin haddeleqa bimqomot sheyyesh sham chashash sakkana bidleqa, verotzim lehachamir al atzman velaasot teshuba al zeh — en mannichin otam, kede shello yimmaneu millekabbot:

Gachelet shel matteket — lo shayyak bah kibbuy min hattora, hoil veenah boeret. Abal asur lekabbotah middibre soperim. Veim hi munnachat bemaqom sherabbim nizzoqim bah — muttar lekabbotah, shebbimqom hezzeq haggup shel rabbim — lo gazeru. Abal gachelet shel etz shayyak bah kibbuy, veap im hi munnachat bemaqom sherabbim nizzoqim bah — asur lekabbotah lehamchayyebim melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, sheissur shel tora lo huttar leolam ella bimqom piqquach nepesh bilbad. Abal lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah enah asura ella middibre soperim — muttar lekabbot apillu gachelet shel etz hammunnachat bemaqom sherabbim nizzoqim bah, shebbimqom hezzeq haggup lo gazeru, ap al pi sheggazeru bimqom hepsed mamon. Veken iqqar. (Veap al pi ken, kol baal nepesh yesh lo lehachamir leatzmo):
